metadata.title: Fortinet stock slumps after earnings, and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
14 hours ago
Fortinet stock slumps after earnings, and other early market movers
Here are some of stocks making notable moves in Thursday's premarket action:
Fortinet stock is diving more than 25% after the cybersecurity company's product revenue grew significantly slower in the latest quarter than it did in the previous one. The shares had jumped 119% this year.
The Fortinet news is hitting other cybersecurity plays, such as Palo Alto Networks, down 5%, and Zscaler, off 6%.
ServiceNow shares are sliding more than 18% after the software group's pipeline of new AI deals was overshadowed by an earnings miss and evidence of slowing contract growth ahead.
Alphabet shares are down more than 10% after the hyperscaler and owner of YouTube reported a third-quarter revenue and earnings miss, stoking fears that artificial intelligence is pressuring its core search-engine business.
Microsoft stock is up 4% after the software and hyperscaler group posted earnings from which investors inferred its AI investments are paying off.
Lumentum stock is following Wednesday's 5.5% gain with a further 6% advance after Bloomberg reported that the optical networking company may be acquired by custom chip maker Marvell Technology, whose shares are down nearly 10%.
Shares of Chipotle Mexican Grill are rallying more than 6% after the food chain stuck with its expectations for modest sales growth this year despite signs of fast-casual fatigue and an affordability crunch.
Carvana shares are jumping 8% after the online used-car retailer reported a surge in profits after sales grew nearly 40%.
